channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Exploding Kittens® 2: Explosive Expansions Pass
item.description: One pass, three major expansions! Become a lion among kittens with the Explosive Expansions Pass. You’ll get instant access to all three expansions – Imploding Kittens, Streaking Kittens and Barking Kittens. Kitties and cards – what more could you want?

item.title: Bits & Bops
item.description: Bits & Bops is a collection of original rhythm mini-games! Filled with catchy music, snappy gameplay and gorgeous, hand-drawn animation, Bits & Bops is sure to brighten your day.

item.title: Bloodthief
item.description: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through haunted crypts and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath.

item.title: CHUCHEL
item.description: CHUCHEL is a comedy adventure game from the creators of Machinarium, Botanicula and Samorost. Join the hairy hero Chuchel and his rival Kekel as they will be facing numerous puzzles and challenges in their quest to retrieve the precious cherry!

item.title: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
item.description: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

item.title: Too Many Toys!
item.description: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
